verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly show a hosted remote MCP endpoint (https://remote.mcp.pipedream.net) that clients connect to via URL and headers, with no server deployment required, supporting SSE/streamable HTTP transports, managed auth, and thousands of downstream tools/APIs. This directly matches the story of pointing an MCP client at a hosted URL to reach tools without infrastructure. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification beyond vendor docs.
